text:
maria: Opening thread for ticket #23456 — customer reports SSO failures after IdP rotated keys. Users see 403 / "Encrypted assertion not decryptable" on login. They say only the encryption cert changed, signing cert stayed the same. Link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/23456

alex: Can you paste the IdP metadata URL and a redacted SAMLResponse sample? Need to check which KeyDescriptor our parser is picking.

maria: Metadata: https://idp.examplecorp.com/metadata.xml. Customer pasted a base64 SAMLResponse (trimmed) — I put the encoded blob in the ticket. Error from our logs: `saml: decryptAssertion: no matching decryption cert for EncryptedKey`

jamie: Quick theory: some IdPs rotate the encryption-only cert and put it in a KeyDescriptor with use="encryption" but also sometimes omit use or flip order. Our parser historically prefers KeyDescriptor use="signing" for key selection, then falls back to encryption; if the metadata omits use attr it picks the first KeyDescriptor.

alex: I pulled the metadata and saw this snippet (redacted):

```
<KeyDescriptor use="encryption">
  <KeyInfo>
    <X509Data>
      <X509Certificate>MIIB...ENCRYPTION_CERT...==</X509Certificate>
    </X509Data>
  </KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
<KeyDescriptor use="signing">
  <KeyInfo>
    <X509Data>
      <X509Certificate>MIIB...SIGNING_CERT...==</X509Certificate>
    </X509Data>
  </KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
```

alex: Notice order: encryption first, signing second. Our parser used the signing key for decryption attempt (wrong), then rejected the encrypted assertion because the key types mismatch.

maria: Customer says they didn't change metadata URL, only rotated the encryption key on their IdP side. They can temporarily re-add the old cert but would prefer a smoother fix on our side.

jamie: Two immediate options:
- short-term: accept encryption KeyDescriptor if signature-based selection fails (config toggle)
- long-term: update metadata key selection to inspect EncryptedData/KeyInfo in the SAMLResponse and pick the matching certificate by fingerprint/KeyName/X509SubjectKeyIdentifier

alex: I reproduced locally with a trimmed SAMLResponse. Repro steps:
1) curl -s https://idp.examplecorp.com/metadata.xml -o meta.xml
2) extract certs: `xmllint --xpath '//KeyDescriptor' meta.xml`
3) decode SAMLResponse: `echo "<BASE64>" | base64 -d > resp.xml`
4) inspect EncryptedKey info: `xmllint --xpath '//*[local-name()=\"EncryptedKey\"]' resp.xml`

alex: The EncryptedKey KeyInfo contains an Issuer/KeyName that matched the new encryption cert's subject CN. But our current resolver tried to use the first signing key that supports RSA and failed.

maria: Customer asked if we can whitelist the new cert thumbprint for their tenant as a stopgap. Is that something we can do without code changes?

jamie: We can add a tenant-level override to accept any KeyDescriptor with use="encryption" if present. That would be a config flip in the SSO connector (no code deploy). I'll prepare the config and steps.

sre-bot: Deployment note: config toggles require a quick-sync to auth-conductor; will be applied within 2 minutes once set.

alex: For the long-term fix, I propose we change key selection algorithm to: (1) parse EncryptedKey KeyInfo from SAMLResponse and try to match X509IssuerSerial/KeyName/X509SKI against metadata certs; (2) fallback to explicit use attribute; (3) fallback to ordering. That will make rotations transparent.

jamie: Agreed. That will also avoid cases where IdP changes ordering. I can own a small PR to the SAML parsing library to add the fingerprint matching. Estimate: 2 dev-days + 1 test-day.

maria: Applying tenant config override now and asked customer to retry. Will paste results.

[~2 minutes later]

maria: Customer reports successful login after override. `Encrypted assertion not decryptable` gone. They validated 6 users. :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll file a follow-up ticket to implement the fingerprint/keyname matching. Also will add unit tests using rotated key metadata permutations.

jamie: I'll draft the small local config docs for on-call to use if other customers hit this during rotations.

maria: Marking ticket escalated->resolved. Leaving this thread open for implementation follow-up. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

alex: Note for release notes: mention SAML resilience improvement and tenant override capability.

sre-bot: Action items created: SAML-1372 (parser matching), DOCS-882 (on-call runbook).

maria: Closing loop with customer and offering post-rotation check. Will reopen if anything else pops up.
